Soft white bread layered with shredded roast chicken, herbed mayo, smashed avocado and cucumber, crusts off, cut into neat fingers. Shred 400g roast chicken meat. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with chopped chives, parsley, a squeeze of lemon and salt, then fold through the chicken. Smash 2 avocados with lemon juice and salt. Spread 6 slices of white bread with avocado, top with the chicken and thin cucumber slices, and close with 6 more slices. Trim the crusts and cut each into 3 fingers.

Strange's fancy life in New York before the crash

Thick rib eye seared hard and basted with garlic thyme butter, sliced with a red wine sauce, potato gratin and charred asparagus. Bake 1kg thinly sliced potatoes layered with 300ml cream, garlic and salt at 180C for 1 hour. Season 2 x 500g rib eyes and sear in a very hot pan for 4 minutes a side. Add 60g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme, and spoon the foaming butter over for 2 minutes. Rest 10 minutes. Reduce 250ml red wine and 250ml stock in the pan by half. Grill 2 bunches asparagus.

s.note: Steamed chicken and ginger dumplings with roasted tomato sesame achar
s.how: Mix 400g chicken mince with 2 spring onions, 1 tbsp grated ginger and a pinch of cumin. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers and steam 10 minutes. Blitz 3 roasted tomatoes with a chilli and 2 tbsp toasted sesame for achar.

s.note: Puff pastry spirals with basil pesto and parmesan, baked golden
s.how: Spread 2 sheets puff pastry with 3 tbsp basil pesto and 50g grated parmesan. Roll up, slice into spirals and brush with egg. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until golden.

m.note: Red lentil dal with cumin ghee, basmati rice and garlic spinach
m.how: Simmer 300g red lentils with 1 tsp turmeric, 3 garlic cloves and ginger in 1L water for 25 minutes. Fry 1 tsp cumin seeds in 2 tbsp ghee and pour over. Serve with 300g basmati rice and spinach wilted with garlic.

w.note: Soft cinnamon scrolls with brown sugar and a simple icing glaze
w.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 250ml warm milk and 50g butter and prove an hour. Roll out, spread with 60g butter, 80g brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll, cut 12 and bake at 190C for 22 minutes. Glaze with 150g icing sugar and milk. Dormammu, I've come to bargain.

d.note: Spiced milk tea with ginger, cardamom and cinnamon
d.how: Simmer 4 black tea bags in 500ml water with sliced ginger, 4 crushed cardamom pods and a cinnamon stick for 5 minutes. Add 500ml milk and raw sugar, bring back to a simmer and strain into cups.
